Amit Soni, Chief Financial Officer, Fusion CX, said: “We delivered a strong performance during Q2FY27, with double-digit growth in revenue and profitability. Reported EBITDA was INR 976 Mn with a margin of 18.6%. PAT rose 31.3% YoY to INR 586 Mn. Cash generation remained strong during the quarter, supporting continued investments in AI capabilities and delivery capacity. With our successful listing in October, we have further strengthened our financial position and flexibility. Around 40% of the IPO proceeds have been deployed to date, primarily towards debt reduction and the Impacx acquisition, in line with the stated objects of the issue. This has also improved our leverage position. The balance proceeds remain allocated towards platform upgrades, overseas debt payments, general corporate purposes and acquisitions, supporting our strategic growth priorities.” Page 3 of 3 Conference Call Details: Monday, November 16th, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST Diamond Pass Click Here Universal Access Number +91 22 6280 1107 | +91 22 7115 8008 The number listed above is universally accessible from all networks and all countries. Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited (Alembic) today announced that it has received final approval from the US Food & Drug Administration (USFDA) for its Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) for Binimetinib Tablets, 15 mg and 45 mg. The approved ANDA is therapeutically equivalent to the reference listed drug product (RLD), Mektovi Tablets, 15 mg, of Array BioPharma Inc. (Array). Binimetinib is a kinase inhibitor indicated, in combination with encorafenib, for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with a BRAF V600E or V600K mutation. It is also indicated, in combination with encorafenib, for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with a BRAF V600E mutation. Flavia Machado Company Secretary & Compliance Officer ACS: 38986 Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Limited Registered Office: P&G Plaza Cardinal Gracias Road, Chakala Andheri (E), Mumbai - 400099 Highly Restricted Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Ltd. announces results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026 Mumbai, November 12, 2026: Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care Ltd. (PGHH) today announced its financial results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Company reported sales of ₹ 1145 crores, flat versus year ago. Profit After Tax (PAT) was reported at ₹196 crores, down 7% versus year ago. In the quarter, the Company experienced a double-digit impact on profitability driven by commodity cost fluctuations and headwinds like raw material and energy costs, as well as unfavorable foreign exchange rates. However, a significant portion of this was offset by the robust productivity program. In the quarter, the company also continued to significantly invest back in innovation and advertising & promotion (versus past quarter) - in an endeavor to position the company for long-term competitiveness and value creation.
